::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 8 [1890s?]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/27
:::

My dear [Anna](people/person_195.qmd)
I am sorry to say I cannot anyhow come on the 16th for it is our [School](organizations/other_107.qmd) examination day, and it will not be over in time. What shall we do without our Chairman who was a tower of strength on the right side

yours sincerely
C M Yonge
